meta.title: Concert in the Park
meta.textType: a paragraph about sports, music, or travel

paragraphs: A Concert in the Park, posted by Lily. On Saturday afternoon, my family went to a concert in the park near our house. My brother Tom plays the drums in the school band. He practiced for many weeks, and he was ready for the day. Actually, the concert was free, so everybody in the town could come. It was a big event for the town, and many families came. Mom, Dad, and I sat on a green mat under a big tree. Do you like live music?

The Trip to the Park. The band came early in a school bus. The students had a lot of luggage, because they carried big bags and long black cases. Tom had less luggage than the others, because he carried only one small bag. The school drums were already in the park. A small truck brought them the day before. The students put their bags next to the stage and checked the drums.

The Program. At the gate, a woman gave us a paper program. It had six songs and the name of each song. "The first song is a slow song," said Dad. "The last song is the loudest." The concert started at exactly four o'clock. The band performed on the stage for one hour. Tom played the drums in four songs, and he did not make one mistake.

The Music. The band played old songs and new songs. In the slow songs, the music was soft, and many people closed their eyes. In the fast songs, the drums were loud, and the children clapped. A small girl danced on the grass in front of us. The sun went behind a big tree, and the air was less hot. I took a photo of Tom behind the big drum.

After the Concert. When the last song ended, everybody clapped for a long time. Tom came to us with a big smile. "How was it?" he asked. "It was excellent!" said Mom. The students took their luggage back to the bus, and we walked home. I am sure that I will go to the next concert, too.
